title: The Cell System — Our Care Structure
definition: The cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of our Church — the extension of the pastoral ministry of our Man of God to every member. In your cell you are nurtured in the Word, edified by the Spirit, you enjoy fellowship, and you are equipped to function in your divine assignment with excellence.
size: 5–25 members meeting weekly in homes, offices, schools, or online (virtual cells)
purposes: Pastoral care, follow-up, and prevailing intercession — no one left behind
Fellowship and growth through the efficacious Word — from glory to glory
Soul-winning and outreach training — winning every man's world to Christ
Leadership development, perfection and multiplication — raised to reign
schedule: Midweek + weekends — each cell sets its own day (e.g., Thursday 6PM, Saturday 5PM). See Directory for cell nearest you.
expectation: Every member belongs to a cell where they grow, serve, and win souls — cell leaders are trained Foundation School graduates.
